expectedTrackId.description: Identity of the track the learner intends to replace.

lyrics.description: Pasted plain-text lyrics, at most 25,000 raw Unicode code points. The backend requires a Unicode letter, rejects C0/C1 controls except tab/LF/CR, and rejects HTTP(S)/www link-only input before whitespace normalization.

allowPartial.description: Legacy compatibility field, accepted but ignored. Replacement uses only the pasted lyrics; partial merging is unavailable.
